products.title: Beyond Sight Oversized Tee – Puff Print Interlock Shirt
products.body_html:
Interlock meets intellect.

The Beyond Sight Tee is cut from premium 310 GSM interlock fabric, offering a soft yet structured drape with a luxe handfeel. Built oversized with puff print symbology on all sides — this piece speaks in riddles, visuals, and rebellion.

This is not your average black graphic tee. It’s a coded manifesto for those tuned into the underground frequency. Loaded with esoteric symbolism, directional glyphs, and spiritual iconography — puff printed across the chest, back, and sleeves — this shirt becomes your statement. Your armor. Your language.

Key Features:

310 GSM heavyweight interlock cotton
All-over raised puff print (front, back, sleeves)
Oversized drop-shoulder fit
Double-stitched hems
Cold-wash recommended
For those who seek what calls in the dark

Care Instructions:
Turn inside out, cold wash only. Do not iron directly on print.
